projection.forward: x = (lon - originLon) * metresPerDegreeLon; z = (originLat - lat) * metresPerDegreeLat

heightfield.sampleAt: cell centre: x = originX + (i + 0.5) * cell, z = originZ + (j + 0.5) * cell
